decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution sits squarely in the firm's aviation and border security knowledge base, and its strong quantified uptake with the UK Home Office and over 30 government APIS schemes lets the firm read the results clearly and keep improving it.

The cyber security awareness module draws on the firm's certified trainers and training infrastructure, so it costs little to maintain, but the lack of reported results limits what the firm can learn from it and leaves it somewhat at risk.

The behaviour analysis system extends the firm's established behavioural detection expertise, giving it the related knowledge to interpret field feedback and refine the system even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The passenger security profiling method builds directly on the firm's core aviation screening know-how and operational experience, so the firm can assimilate learning from deployments and improve it.

The travel and document verification platform is close to the firm's document-check services for airlines and complements Product A, so the firm can readily interpret its market results and apply them, especially after the related travel health API was withdrawn.
